messages:
alex: Quick flag — Cost Explorer and our runtime hours are diverging for GPU commitments in us-west-2. CE shows ~70-75% coverage on the renewal bucket, but infra telemetry reports ~88% actual runtime for p4d/g5. Renewal window for some SPs/RIs in 6 days. Anyone seen this pattern after scale tests?

maria: Timeline? Did the zone rebalance last week change anything?

alex: It started immediately after the mass scale test on 2213996000. Coverage monitor tripped this morning.

sam: Ran a basic join to compare SavingsPlan/RI billed hours vs our cluster runtime_hours. Simplified query: 
```
-- savingsplan/ri vs runtime (30d)
SELECT sku, account_id, SUM(billed_hours) billed, SUM(runtime_hours) runtime
FROM billing.export b
JOIN infra.runtime r USING(hour, sku, account_id)
WHERE hour >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY sku, account_id
HAVING billed < runtime * 0.9;
```
Results show several member accounts with billed hours ~15-25% lower than runtime for p4d/g5 families in us-west-2.

billing-bot: :warning: Coverage anomaly detected: us-west-2 GPU family mismatch. Ticket INC-8015 opened.

ravi: Usual suspects: cross-account allocation (SPs attached to payer but instances run in members without link), family/type normalization mismatches, and short-lived/spot instances excluded from SP mapping. Also exchanges/modifies can create temporary accounting gaps.

jada: I'll pull DescribeSavingsPlans + DescribeReservedInstances + consolidated billing mapping. Give me 2 hours.

sam: I'll dump CE utilization and our runtime dump to s3://redwood-infra/ops/221400_sp_diff.json and run a diff. Also checking for RIs with null owner fields.

alex: If we confirm orphaned capacity, pause auto-renew and prepare a consolidation plan. We should avoid renewing blind.

maria: I'll audit K8s autoscaler launch templates and kubelet tags — if the autoscaler removed billing tags during the test, CE mapping will break.

sam: Quick jq check on the RI dump: 
```
jq '.ReservedInstances[] | select(.InstanceType=="p4d.24xlarge") | {RI:.ReservedInstancesId, State:.State, OwnerId:.OwnerId}' ri_dump_usw2.json
```
Found several RIs with OwnerId null or set to legacy partner account.

ravi: OwnerId null usually indicates exchange/marketplace or cross-account share. Finance mapping table will clarify.

jada: Data-ask to finance submitted for partner purchases and exchange logs. cc @finance.

billing-bot: :white_check_mark: INC-8015 updated with RI and SP dumps. Automated re-check in 3h.

alada: Note: last quarter some SPs were modified regionally vs zonal which changes how hours are attributed in CE. Worth checking scope (regional vs zonal) in the dump.

alex: Action items — (1) sam: full diff of DescribeSavingsPlans/DescribeReservedInstances vs runtime with per-account breakdown, highlight accounts with >10% uncovered hours (due EOD); (2) jada: get finance mapping + exchange history (in flight); (3) maria: tag audit across clusters and autoscaler configs (due 4h); (4) ravi: draft renewal hold rec if uncovered >15% in target pool.

sam: Ack. I'll attach diffs to INC-8015 and create a short CSV: s3://redwood-infra/ops/221400_sp_diff.csv.

budget-bot: :information_source: Reminder: Upcoming SP/RI renewals in 6 days. Projected annual spend for p4d mix if renewed without adjustment: $1.05M.

alex: No renewals until we validate mapping. If anyone finds a quick remediation (tag patch or account re-link), we'll run a hotfix.

maria: I'll prioritize the kube autoscaler tag fix — likely a 10-min helm roll.

alex: Thanks all. Re-check in this thread once EOD reports are in.
